description: A patch set for DeepSeek Harness: 42 registered defects, each with evidence, guards and limits.
plugin_description: DeepSeek Harness patch set that intercepts MALFORMED_RESPONSE streams, splits fused tool-call arguments, re-throws unprovable buffers, and names the deterministic refusals it does not retry.
core_description: Pure repair and redaction engine for the dsh-remedy patch set. Nothing unproven is ever emitted; a failure it cannot split is re-thrown unchanged.
release_blurb:
### Release status

`0.4.13` is shipped and published as `latest` for both `dsh-remedy` and `dsh-remedy-core`, with `0.4.12` as the previous release and `0.4.11` before it.

Six patches are verified on a real host: a fusion was repaired end to end, a synthesized call was dispatched, a budget refusal wrote a non-zero `refused` instead of pretending to repair, a tool call with no identity was rewritten under a traceable id, a dropped closing delimiter was restored at its only provable site, and the installed `bin` on POSIX really runs. Every other patch is `tested`, and the repository registers 42 patches: 6 verified and 36 tested.

This release carries P-0042: the host refused one reasoning level 37 times while the profile still fixed it, and nothing compared the two. `scan` now keeps the refused level when the host's own sentence names it, and `explain` prints the conflict and exits 1. The seam cannot move the level — that was measured, not assumed.

Live evidence: [data/results/prestep-enter-2026-11-15T17-55-00.000Z.json](data/results/prestep-enter-2026-11-15T17-55-00.000Z.json), [data/results/live-desktop-2026-11-15T17-12-40.000Z.json](data/results/live-desktop-2026-11-15T17-12-40.000Z.json), [data/results/live-linux-2026-11-15T15-00-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-linux-2026-11-15T15-00-00.000Z.json) and [data/results/live-2026-11-10T14-45-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-2026-11-10T14-45-00.000Z.json).
